description: This file defines a generic ObserverManager class for maintaining collections of observers, with support for subscribing, unsubscribing, notifying, and managing expiration of observers. It includes a derived class with a specific key type and a lightweight logging mechanism.

classes.name: ObserverManager<TObserver>
classes.description: A derived class which manages observers identified by IAddressable, with expiration and logging.

classes.name: ObserverManager<TIdentity, TObserver>
classes.description: A generic class for managing a collection of observers with expiration, thread-safety, and notification features.

methods.name: ObserverManager<TObserver>.<init>
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the manager with an expiration timespan and a logger.

methods.name: ObserverManager<TIdentity, TObserver>.<init>
methods.description: Constructor initializing expiration, logger, and time retrieval function.

methods.name: ObserverManager<TIdentity, TObserver>.Clear
methods.description: Removes all observers from the collection.

methods.name: ObserverManager<TIdentity, TObserver>.Subscribe
methods.description: Adds or updates an observer with specific identity.

methods.name: ObserverManager<TIdentity, TObserver>.Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes the observer with the specified identity.

methods.name: ObserverManager<TIdentity, TObserver>.Notify (async)
methods.description: Asynchronously notifies all observers, handling expiration and exceptions.

methods.name: ObserverManager<TIdentity, TObserver>.Notify (sync)
methods.description: Synchronously notifies observers matching a predicate.

methods.name: ObserverManager<TIdentity, TObserver>.ClearExpired
methods.description: Removes all expired observers based on LastSeen and expiration duration.

methods.name: ObserverManager<TIdentity, TObserver>.CreateReadSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a read snapshot for thread-safe enumeration.

methods.name: ObserverManager<TIdentity, TObserver>.GetWritableObservers
methods.description: Provides a writable dictionary, copying if necessary for thread safety.
